relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: Paeonol relieves neuropathic pain by modulating microglial M1 and M2 phenotypes through the RhoA/p38 MAPK pathway.

relationships.subject: Paeonol
relationships.evidence_quote: Paeonol decreased IBA-1, IL1β, RhoA, RhoA-GTP, COX2, Rock1, and p-p38MAPK levels in the spinal dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: RhoA/p38MAPK pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: This finding indicates that the RhoA/p38MAPK pathway can promote the M1 polarization of microglia.

key_findings: Paeonol relieves CCI-induced neuropathic pain by shifting spinal microglia from M1 to M2 via RhoA/p38MAPK.
Paeonol reduced RhoA, Rock1, p-p38MAPK, COX2 and IL1β in the spinal dorsal horn.
